name: Outfame
description_en:
Outfame is a hosted audience-growth service currently centered on Instagram, with Instagram and TikTok included in its help documentation. Users supply a profile and audience signals, prepare settings in a trial dashboard and activate a paid growth campaign. This differs from a conventional content scheduler: its operational guide says it does not post on the user’s behalf. Paid plans also describe AI post suggestions and reporting.

The meaningful evaluation is whether the delivered audience is relevant and whether the campaign’s permissions, renewal price and cancellation behavior match expectations. Public sources disagree on important conditions, including trial length/card requirements, refund timing, growth activity after cancellation and the use of automated interactions. The profile preserves those conflicts. Official-API, real-follower, compliance and growth claims have not been independently validated; neither testimonials nor a dashboard mockup demonstrate outcomes for a new account.
description_zh:
Outfame 是托管受众增长服务，当前以 Instagram 为中心，帮助文档同时包括 Instagram 与 TikTok。用户提供账户及受众信号，在试用仪表盘准备设置，再启动付费增长活动。它不同于常规内容排程器：操作指南说不会代用户发布。付费计划另描述 AI 帖子建议及报告。

有效评估是交付受众是否相关，以及活动权限、续费价、取消行为是否符合预期。公开来源在关键条件上不一致，包括试用长度／银行卡、退款时点、取消后增长活动、自动互动使用。此档案保留冲突。官方 API、真人关注者、合规及增长主张未独立验证，证言或仪表盘示意不能证明新账户效果。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current monthly cards show Go $49, Grow $69 and Glory $129 per account. The FAQ/terms identify monthly signup amounts as first-month promotions; exact regular renewal rates and annual totals were not established. The rendered page mixes savings labels with monthly cards, so no normalized price is assigned. Grow help includes 15 AI post suggestions/month and Glory 30, plus higher-tier reporting/support; these do not establish unlimited generation. A limited trial is documented, not sustained-free growth. Confirm checkout term, currency/tax and the applicable refund window before purchase.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前月付卡片逐账户显示 Go $49、Grow $69、Glory $129。FAQ／条款称月付注册金额为首月优惠，准确常规续费及年付总额未确定。所读页面将节省标签与月付卡片混排，因此不分配标准化价格。Grow 帮助含每月 15 条 AI 帖子建议，Glory 30 条，另有高档报告／支持，不证明无限生成。文档是有限试用，并非持续免费增长。购买前需确认结算期限、币种／税及适用退款窗口。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Prepare an audience brief before starting the paid campaign
sections.title_zh: 启动付费活动前准备受众简报
sections.en: The setup guide accepts similar accounts, relevant hashtags, target countries/cities and demographic/interest preferences, plus adjustable growth speed. Its trial is a preparation phase; the paid upgrade activates targeting. Editorial local-business example: supply relevant nearby peers and service locations, then compare incoming followers with the actual customer area instead of judging only the total count. Those preferences are targeting signals, not proof every follower matches them. Content quality and ordinary account activity remain part of the documented workflow; a growth subscription does not replace supplying accurate content.
sections.zh: 设置指南接受相似账户、相关标签、国家／城市、人口特征／兴趣偏好，以及可调增长速度。试用是准备阶段，升级付费后启动定位。编辑本地企业示例：提供相关附近同行及服务地点，再比较新增关注者与真实客户区域，不能只看总数。偏好是定位信号，不能证明每位关注者都符合。内容质量及正常账户活动仍属于文档流程，购买增长服务不替代提供准确内容。

sections.title_en: The public description does not establish a consistent interaction method
sections.title_zh: 公开说明尚未确定一致的互动机制
sections.en: The operational How Outfame Works guide describes organic exposure and explicitly says it never posts, sends spam or takes account control. Safety help says it avoids follow/unfollow, mass following and aggressive automation. Yet the Content navigation opens an Instagram Bot page claiming automated likes, follows and comments; another AI page lists paid advertising, micro-interactions and human assistance. These accounts of the method conflict. Editorial procurement: obtain an account-specific explanation of actions and requested permissions before enabling service. No official-API assertion here establishes independently verified platform approval, permitted actions or protection from restrictions.
sections.zh: How Outfame Works 操作指南描述自然曝光，明确不代发、不发垃圾消息、不接管账户；安全帮助说不用关注／取关、批量关注及激进自动化。但 Content 导航打开的 Instagram Bot 页声称自动点赞、关注、评论，另一 AI 页列付费广告、微互动及人工辅助，方法说明冲突。编辑采购建议：启用前取得针对目标账户的动作及权限说明。此处官方 API 宣称不能确定独立验证的平台批准、获准动作或免受限制。

sections.title_en: A trial prepares settings rather than demonstrating growth
sections.title_zh: 试用准备设置，并非演示涨粉
sections.en: The dedicated February 2026 trial guide provides three days for analytics, settings and AI tools, with no follower growth until paid activation. December 2025 terms instead describe one day. The AI landing says a card is required at checkout, while the Bot landing says no card. These are unresolved eligibility and billing conflicts, not interchangeable offers. Editorial evaluation: inspect the exact checkout duration and charge date, then use trial access to review account identity, targeting controls and available data. A lack of follower change during that preparation period is consistent with the trial guide.
sections.zh: 2026 年 2 月试用专页提供三天查看分析、设置及 AI 工具，付费启动前不涨粉；2025 年 12 月条款却写一天。AI 页说结算需银行卡，Bot 页说免卡。这些资格及计费冲突未解决，不能当可互换优惠。编辑评估建议：检查准确结算时长及收费日，再用试用审阅账户身份、定位及可得数据。准备期间关注者未变符合试用指南。

sections.title_en: Calibration language is not proof of audience quality
sections.title_zh: 校准说明不能证明受众质量
sections.en: The post-signup guide describes learning from the profile, recent posts, niche and similar-account interactions. It allows slower or uneven growth and unexpected-looking followers during initial weeks, with improvement presented as a vendor expectation. The terms say follower quantities are not guaranteed and acknowledge unwanted fake/inactive followers cannot be completely prevented, contrasting with universal real-follower marketing. Editorial measurement: record a baseline, inspect relevance of a sample, profile visits and actual inquiries over a defined period. Neither waiting longer nor seeing a rising total independently confirms relevant people, retention or incremental business.
sections.zh: 注册后指南描述从账户、近期帖子、细分及相似账户互动学习，允许最初数周增长慢／不均及看似意外的关注者，改善属于厂商预期。条款说不保证数量，也承认无法完全阻止不需要的假／不活跃关注者，与普遍真人营销有差异。编辑测量建议：记录基线，在明确期间检查样本相关性、主页访问及真实咨询。等待更久或总数上升都不能独立确认相关真人、留存或业务增量。

sections.title_en: Reporting features still need an account-level data check
sections.title_zh: 报告功能仍需逐账户核验数据
sections.en: The analytics page describes follower trends, engagement, audience demographics, content performance, AI activity and CSV export by dates/metrics, included with plans. Its real-time and attribution language remains vendor documentation; no refresh latency, missing-data semantics or causal method was verified. Editorial comparison: use consistent dates, distinguish platform follower changes from service-attributed activity and inspect the available export. Plan-level weekly reports and post suggestions are separate entitlements. A content suggestion is not a scheduled or successfully published post, particularly given the operational no-posting statement.
sections.zh: 分析页描述关注者趋势、互动、受众人口特征、内容效果、AI 活动及按日期／指标导出 CSV，随计划包含。实时及归因措辞仍是厂商文档，未核刷新延迟、缺失数据含义或因果方法。编辑比较建议：统一日期，区分平台关注者变化与服务归因活动，并检查可得导出。计划周报及帖子建议是独立权益。内容建议不等于排程或成功发布，尤其操作指南明确不代发。

sections.title_zh: 多个账户意味着多个订阅
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says one login can hold multiple Instagram accounts, each with its own Go, Grow or Glory plan and targeting; one saved card may pay for all and no account minimum is stated. The agency page suggests distinct countries, languages, interests, peers and hashtags per client. This establishes account organization, not granular staff permissions, approval gates or a verified bulk discount. Editorial agency setup: budget each account separately and inspect its active plan/targeting before comparing results. A localized marketing page also does not prove the dashboard or support operates in that language.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 说一个登录可包含多个 Instagram 账户，每个有独立 Go、Grow、Glory 计划及定位，一张已存卡可付全部，未列账户最低数。代理机构页建议逐客户分开国家、语言、兴趣、同行及标签。这能确定账户组织，不能确定精细员工权限、审批门槛或已核批量折扣。编辑机构设置：逐账户预算，比较前检查其活动计划／定位。本地化营销页也不能证明仪表盘或支持使用该语言。

sections.title_en: Self-service cancellation exists, but growth-stop timing conflicts
sections.title_zh: 存在自助取消，但停止增长时点冲突
sections.en: The cancellation guide uses Profile → Settings → Billing → Manage Subscription, retains access until the current period ends and warns trial users to cancel before charging. Plans help also says growth continues to period end. The separate cancellation/refund article instead says all growth activity stops once canceled. Current homepage advice to contact support is therefore not the only documented route, and actual activity timing remains unclear. Editorial offboarding: keep the cancellation confirmation and verify both renewal status and campaign state. Do not assume removing a social connection, ending a conversation or requesting a refund completes subscription cancellation.
sections.zh: 取消指南路径为 Profile → Settings → Billing → Manage Subscription，可访问至当前周期结束，并提醒试用收费前取消。计划帮助也说增长持续到周期末，另一取消／退款文却说取消即停止全部增长。当前首页建议联系支持并非唯一文档路径，实际活动停止时点仍不明。编辑退出建议：保存取消确认并同时检查续费及活动状态。不能假设断开社交连接、结束聊天、申请退款就完成取消订阅。

sections.title_en: Net-growth refund rules differ from promised follower ranges
sections.title_zh: 净增长退款规则不同于宣传关注者范围
sections.en: Pricing and terms describe a monthly refund if no net-positive Instagram growth after 30 days; February help instead uses the first seven paid days. The help also permits requests for accidental charges within 24 hours and review when technical issues prevent a full service month. Those conditions differ from advertised monthly follower ranges or a guaranteed count. The terms disclaim uninterrupted/error-free operation and responsibility for platform actions; help likewise cannot guarantee protection. Editorial failure handling: preserve start/end counts, dates, charge and issue details, then obtain the applicable refund terms. There is no documented universal numerical-growth or conversion guarantee to rely on here.
sections.zh: 定价及条款描述 30 天后 Instagram 无净正增长可退当月费用，2 月帮助却用付费前七天。帮助还允许误扣后 24 小时申请、因技术问题未完整服务一个月时审查。这些条件不同于宣传月关注者范围或保证数量。条款不保证持续无错运营，也不承担平台动作，帮助同样不保证保护。编辑失败处理：保留起止计数、日期、扣款及问题详情，再取得适用退款条件。此处没有可依赖的统一数字增长或转化保证。

seo.title_en: Outfame: targeting workflow, trial and refund conflicts
seo.title_zh: Outfame：定位流程、试用及退款冲突
seo.description_en: Review Outfame audience targeting, preparation-only trial, per-account pricing, cancellation timing and conflicting growth claims.
seo.description_zh: 核对 Outfame 受众定位、仅准备的试用、逐账户定价、取消时点及增长主张冲突。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Outfame Instagram growth workflow and purchase conditions
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Actual interaction mechanisms, requested permissions, official platform approval, follower authenticity and outcome claims were not independently verified.
research_gaps.zh: 实际互动机制、所需权限、官方平台批准、关注者真实性及效果主张未独立验证。

research_gaps.en: Trial length/card, regular renewal price, annual totals, cancellation activity timing and 7-versus-30-day guarantee conflicts remain unresolved.
research_gaps.zh: 试用长度／银行卡、常规续费、年付总额、取消活动时点、七天与三十天保证冲突未解决。

research_gaps.en: Complete TikTok plan parity, granular staff roles, data freshness/retention, export coverage, regional access and dashboard languages remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 完整 TikTok 计划一致性、精细员工角色、数据新鲜度／保留、导出覆盖、地区访问及仪表盘语言未核。

research_gaps.en: Source licence and self-hosting remain unknown; website material rights do not establish source-code licensing.
research_gaps.zh: 源码许可及自托管未知，网站素材权利不能确定源码许可。

research_gaps.en: No account connected, permissions granted, paid campaign started, content generated, subscription canceled or outcome measured.
research_gaps.zh: 未连接账户、授予权限、启动付费活动、生成内容、取消订阅或测量效果。
